Specification of Diagnostics
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_DM_02000] Fault memory addressing by the scope parameter
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04259
⌈
If a SOVD request to read or delete faults with a provided query parameter "scope" is
received, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall read or delete faults in the fault
memory where "scope" is equal to
DiagnosticMemoryDestination
.
shortName
.
⌋
[SWS_DM_02001] Default fault memory for SOVD requests without scope param-
eter
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04259
⌈
If a SOVD request to read or delete faults without query parameter "scope" is received,
the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall read or delete faults in the primary fault
memory provided by
DiagnosticMemoryDestinationPrimary
.
⌋
7.3.3.5.5 SOVD API – Operations
[SWS_DM_02178] Support of
SOVD
method
control of operations
from an
Entity
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04258, RS_Diag_04260
⌈
The DM shall support the SOVD method
control of operations
according to
ASAM SOVD[5][14].
⌋
[SWS_DM_01405]
SOVD
operations
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262
⌈
Each
DiagnosticSovdOperation
shall express a SOVD operation.
⌋
[SWS_DM_01390]
SOVD
operations request and response parameters
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262
⌈
The values for the key parameters in the request body and response body of the
SOVD methods
•
Start execution of an operation
, (see 7.3.3.5.5.5)
•
Terminate execution of an operation
, (see 7.3.3.5.5.6)
•
Read the status of an operation execution
(see 7.3.3.5.5.7)
shall be represented as JSON object literal.
The literal shall have one entry per
element
with key derived from the
shortName
of
the corresponding
DiagnosticSovdContentElement
.
⌋
